scoring_justification: Absolute CO desorption barriers and HER limiting potentials depend on the specific DFT implementation and the chosen gas-phase reference energies (CO and H2), which are not uniquely specified by the paper. Therefore only the qualitative trend (Ni vs Co ordering) can be reliably verified. This is a structural (trend) scoring, the strongest feasible tier.

outputs.description: Compiled total or free energies of bare surface and adsorbed intermediates for each active site model. The checker verifies model presence and energy self-consistency.

Derived CO desorption free-energy barriers and HER limiting potentials. The checker verifies the relative ordering (Ni sites have lower CO barriers and more negative HER potentials than Co sites) and a sign check.

output_contract.notes: Only the four single-atom models (Ni@SV, Ni-N@SV, Co@SV, Co-N@SV) are required. Double-vacancy variants are optional. The absolute DFT energies and derived barriers are not scored to exact values; the reproduction target is the correct qualitative trend between Ni and Co sites.

steps.description: Verify compiled_energies.json contains all four required models (Ni@SV, Ni-N@SV, Co@SV, Co-N@SV) with required fields.
Verify derived_barriers.json contains the four required models with required fields.

Check internal consistency: for each model the CO desorption barrier and HER limiting potential are consistent with the energies in compiled_energies.json (the gas-phase reference shifts are the same across models).
Verify that Ni sites have lower CO desorption barrier than the corresponding Co sites for each structural pair (SV and N-doped SV).
Verify that Ni sites have more negative HER limiting potential than the corresponding Co sites for each pair.
